'''Petrified Blood''' is a [[spell]] that [[reservation|reserves]] [[mana]] to protect the character's lower half of their maximum [[life]] by causing a portion of the immediate life [[loss]] from [[hit]]s to be lost over time instead. At higher skill levels, the amount of life loss over time is reduced, even though the percentage of immediate life loss prevented remains constant. As a drawback, the character cannot recover life above [[Low life|low life]] by any means except with flasks and {{il|Temporal Rift}}. Skills also gain an additional life cost while the character is above low life.

==Skill functions and interactions==
===Recovering Life===
* "Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life to above Low Life" can be interpreted as "Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life above the Low Life '''threshold'''", meaning ''counting'' as on low life with e.g. {{il|Coward's Legacy}} will not allow you to fill your life to the normal maximum, as the threshold is unchanged.
** So, increasing your low life threshold with the {{c|mod|You count as on Low Life while at 55% of maximum Life or below}} [[Life Mastery]] passive will increase the amount of life you can recover up to without flasks, but not the amount of damage Petrified Blood can mitigate, as it states it will only protect you against life loss below ''half'' life.
* [[Life leech]] will attempt to recover life past the low life threshold. Since leech only ends when you are at maximum unreserved life, this effectively gives you an "overleech" effect like [[Brutal Fervour]], as long as you have more unreserved life than your low life threshold.
** In the same vein, [[The Agnostic]] will continuously drain your mana to recover life, since it can never recover your life to full.
* Other life recovery sources will only continue to work if temporarily dropping into low life.
* Life recovery from any type of [[flask]] will recover your life above low life (Ex. {{il|Forbidden Taste}}, {{c|mod|Non-instant Mana Recovery from Flasks is also Recovered as Life}} mod).

===Effect on maximum hit pool===
* While on low life, Petrified Blood reduces the maximum damage you can take from a single hit without dying. With PB active, a hit needs to deal 83.33% of your maximum life to oneshot you at 50% life. However, it reduces the total amount of life loss from damage, making it synergize well with characters that have high Life pools.
* Conversely, Petrified Blood can still be used when the character is above low life. This increases the character's ability to withstand oneshots or bursts of damage that bring it below low life. However, most characters will not be able to stay above low life because of the added life costs and non-flask recovery being prevented.
** At full life with Petrified Blood active, a hit must deal 133.33% of your maximum life to oneshot.
* Petrified Blood does not mitigate [[damage over time]], so characters that remain at low life will be more vulnerable to it.

===Miscellaneous===
* You cannot directly mitigate the life loss over time from Petrified Blood in any way, not even from sources of damage immunity like a Divine Shrine. 
* Petrified Blood does not interact with resources lost before life, such as [[energy shield]] or [[mana]]. 

===Synergies===

* [[Pain Attunement]]'s bonus and other such conditional bonuses can be maintained since non-flask recovery will never bring the character above low life.
* As stated above, Petrified Blood can grant an "overleech" effect.
* [[Master Surgeon]] lets the [[Pathfinder]] Ascendancy class maintain uptime on Life flasks to stay above low life most of the time while using Petrified Blood. Any damage taken that exceeds the low life threshold is reduced, increasing the amount of damage it takes to get oneshot.
* {{il|Divination Distillate}} can be maintained by using the added life cost to counteract the flask's life recovery.
* Petrified Blood will not interfere with Cast When Damage Taken setups, since it delays life loss and not damage taken.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/mcqir3/314_league_info_megathread/gtzsmzn/</ref>
* Since Petrified Blood's "% of Life loss prevented this way is lost over 4 seconds" is the exact same duration as default [[Recoup]] effect, it can be used to directly counter Petrified Blood's Life Lost over Time. For a Level 21/20 Quality Petrified Blood Gem, exactly 30% Damage taken recouped as Life negates The Life lost from Petrified Blood.
* {{il|Bloodnotch}} and [[Unfaltering]] can be used to instantly recover 100% of the immediate life loss if the player was stunned.
* [[Champion]]'s [[First to Strike, Last to Fall]] can be activated by using a life flask to exit low life (provided unreserved life is above the low life threshold), then re-entering low life via taking damage or paying for skill costs.
* The life loss delay is multiplicative with {{il|Progenesis}}<ref>https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Progenesis#cite_note-1</ref>.
